title: Windowed quant regression sentinel: cohort-aware golden set + ensemble pass/fail
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated accuracy validation harness that evaluates FP8/INT8 rollouts against a stratified golden prompt archive using windowed and cohort-aware metrics. Goals: 1) detect small but actionable accuracy regressions introduced by calibration/quant profiles, 2) minimize false positives through statistical controls and ensemble scoring, 3) produce deterministic pass/fail decisions for CI and gated rollouts. This ticket implements the orchestration, metric aggregation, and gating policy for a first-pass sentinel that will be used by rollout pipelines and Adhoc evaluation runs.
implementation_notes: Create a golden prompt archive in S3 with tags for intent/cohort, average length, and stability seed. Path: s3://redwood-goldens/quant/windowed-v1
Evaluation harness will run model variants at two sampling settings: deterministic (temp=0) for log-likelihood comparisons and production sampling (configurable) for semantic similarity checks

Compute per-sample metrics: delta log-prob (model_fp8 vs model_fp16 baseline), embedding cosine (OpenAI-style embeddings or internal encoder), token-level perplexity change, and response token overlap ratio
Aggregate metrics over sliding windows of 1000 prompts and also per-cohort windows (min 200 prompts) to detect localized regressions
Use multiple statistical tests: paired bootstrap for mean delta log-prob, Wilcoxon signed-rank for nonparametric shifts, and Bonferroni correction across cohorts to control family-wise error rate
Produce an ensemble acceptance score: weighted combination of normalized metrics. Weights are configuration parameters (default: log-prob 0.5, embedding cosine 0.3, perplexity 0.15, overlap 0.05)
Implement threshold gates with hysteresis: fail if ensemble score breaches threshold for two consecutive windows OR if any cohort exhibits a per-metric breach beyond critical thresholds
Integrate with calibration pipeline to automatically pick calibration profile metadata used for the run (profile id, seed, histogram bins) and include in result metadata
Persist run artifacts and raw telemetry to our evaluation bucket, expose summarized metrics to Console dashboard at /dashboards/quant/validation-sentinel
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run end-to-end against a submitted model artifact and baseline (fp16) and produce a single JSON verdict with metrics and pass/fail reason
Ensemble score computed and stored; thresholds configurable via config repo; default thresholds produce <2% false positive rate on historical rollout dataset
Cohortized alerts fire when a single intent cohort shows degradation even if global score passes
Sliding window logic implemented with window size and step configurable; default window=1000, step=500
Results visible in Console dashboard and linked from CI job; PR gating uses verdict to block canary promotion
Automated nightly run executes on canonical golden set and stores time-series results for drift monitoring
testing_plan: Unit tests for metric calculations (delta log-prob, cosine similarity, perplexity), including edge cases for empty responses and truncation
Integration test that runs the harness against a synthetic baseline and an intentionally degraded quantized model to ensure failure path is exercised
Statistical test harness that replays historical rollouts (last 6 months) to estimate false positive / false negative rates for default thresholds
Load test to validate evaluation cluster can process a 10k golden-run in under 10 minutes using batching and KV caching
Manual review with PM and applied-ML for at least one FP8 calibration profile before enabling CI gates
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Enable harness in read-only mode; populate dashboard and email alerts to eng-quant team (target: 1 week)
Phase 2: Use harness verdict as advisory for small internal canaries for dedicated capacity rollouts (1 week)
Phase 3: Enable automatic CI gating for non-prod branches; require human override for production canaries (2 weeks)
Phase 4: After 4 weeks of stable ops, allow auto-blocking of canary promotions for regression severity >= critical
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Overfitting gates to fixed golden set -> Mitigation: rotate goldens monthly and add a random holdout cohort
Risk: False positives due to stochastic sampling -> Mitigation: compare deterministic (temp=0) metrics and average multiple sampled runs
Risk: Slow runs at scale -> Mitigation: use cached KV states, batching, and run windowed subsets in parallel
Risk: Metric conflicts (some metrics indicate improvement while others degrade) -> Mitigation: weighted ensemble with configurable weights and explicit tie-break rules
